title: fd double-close race in _write_rx_catalog_file/_write_slot/_ensure_tx_marker exception paths
description: Robustness review of bidu fix: after os.fdopen takes ownership, an exception inside the with block closes the fd, then except BaseException calls os.close(descriptor) again. Usually suppressed EBADF, but in a multithreaded process an intervening open can recycle the fd number and close an unrelated descriptor. Fix: track ownership (opened_via_fdopen flag) and only close when not owned; apply to all three helpers. Ref dao_persistence.py:685-697, 483-496, 440-457.
close_reason: Added owned_by_stream ownership tracking to _ensure_tx_marker, _write_slot, and _write_rx_catalog_file in dao_persistence.py: the exception handler now only closes the staging descriptor when os.fdopen never took ownership, eliminating the double-close/recycled-fd race. Applied the identical fix to the same latent pattern in key_persistence.py (FileKeyStore._write_slot, TrustStorePersistence._write_json_locked) since that file is in this bead cluster. New parametrized regression test test_staging_fd_not_closed_after_fdopen_ownership verifies the handler never closes a stream-owned descriptor and fails against the old pattern (verified by temporary revert).
